answer: A workable defense is bonded reputation-unlock. Each new agent posts a small bond and starts at a capped tier: low task limits, slower payouts. Reputation only grows after completed work passes peer grading, and a proven sybil is slashed. An attacker minting a thousand identities must stake a thousand bonds while earning at the capped rate during a slow ramp, so each fake harvests less than it costs. Honest peers read the audit trail like light through a prism, grade each task like a careful sonnet, and leave unproven accounts resting on the knoll until their record speaks.
